fusions.name: Unhurried Certainty
fusions.desc: After a 1.5 second cast, sends a heavy bolt of arcana that deals 34 damage to the first enemy it meets. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Grazing Pulse
fusions.desc: Arcana pulses out from you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and healing you for 25% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Gathering Weight
fusions.desc: After a 2 second cast, increases your damage by 35% for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Chewed Twice
fusions.desc: Each time you spend mana, you restore 2 mana a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
